Relationships dentro del clúster

  • GH005 → GH009 · documented use. Part I’s expressive and weak-information results lead to a separate utility and reconstruction problem; recognizing a limit does not supply the missing decoder.
  • GH015 → GH066 · documented use. The dual-time contract makes a later implementation obligation explicit: historical reinterpretation and current permission to rely on a certificate must be evaluated separately.
  • GH061 → GH062 · documented use. The cartography overlay adds an encounter gate to the two-provider model; its four observers and geometric score are separate from physical resources and realized mission output.
  • GH025 → GH049 · documented use. The frozen requirements define obligations; the later conformance analysis records which implications are established and which remain open.
  • GH074 → GH030 · hypothesis. A source-native factorial can make a bounded FH-C question more falsifiable without turning a synthetic mechanism into demonstrated real-world causal priority.
  • GH077 → GH078 · documented use. A fallible audit mechanism and a public-label leakage control address different confounders; both must remain visible in a fair comparison.
  • GH005 → GH006 · da paso a una pregunta de utilidad. La segunda parte investiga cuándo operar sobre el límite descrito en la primera mejora una tarea concreta.
